title: Multi-mode magneto-Rayleigh-Taylor (MRT) growth on a Be liner
description: Ellison benchmark 2. Multi-mode MRT on an initially solid beryllium liner imploded on the 20-MA Z accelerator (100- or 200-ns current rise). Penetrating radiography resolves the evolving, azimuthally-correlated MRT structure prior to and during stagnation. The simulation must qualitatively reproduce the multi-mode structure and amplitude growth.

primary_source.paper: Penetrating Radiography of Imploding and Stagnating Beryllium Liners on the Z Accelerator

companion_source.paper: Beryllium liner implosion experiments on the Z accelerator in preparation for magnetized liner inertial fusion

setup.note: broadband (multi-mode) surface seeding; azimuthally-correlated MRT structure near stagnation

data.observable: multi-mode MRT amplitude growth (dominant-mode envelope) vs time
